scope.coverage_note: 81 of 146 tier-2 chunks extracted (~55%); this QA covers only the extracted subset

papers_raw_pmid.basis: raw pmid (no canonical_pmid yet at QA time)

null_entity_rate.note: tier-1 comparable = 0.470; entity-free rows are symptom-burden/comorbidity findings, not extraction loss

comorbidity_type_rows_entity_free.note: comorbidity analysis MUST include entity-free rows or it misses most claims

invariants.suite_verified_live: yes - planted regressions caught 4 invariant families
invariants.correction: I5 originally keyed duplicates on (pmid,finding_text,chunk) and flagged 47 groups; ALL 47 differ in >=1 field (entity/relation/pathway), i.e. one sentence carrying several distinct findings. Key corrected to full-row.

fill_rates.note: pots_subtype drop (0.5% vs tier-1 14.5%) is expected: tier-2 is EDS/ME-CFS/MCAS literature where POTS subtyping does not apply
fill_rates.tier2_richer_in: gene_marker 16.3% vs 7.7%; ontology grounding 19.0% vs 12.7% (full-text names genes abstracts omit)

duplicate_title_audit.basis: same normalized title with >1 pmid; merge requires first-author AND year agreement
duplicate_title_audit.note: both retained groups share title+first author but differ in year (republication in another venue) - correctly NOT merged

singleton_hypothesis_test.claim: unmapped singleton entity strings are one-off mentions, not near-duplicates of head strings
singleton_hypothesis_test.method: 400 sampled singletons fuzzy-matched (ratio>=0.90) against the 2,200-string mapping head
singleton_hypothesis_test.verdict: CONFIRMED - 3.8% near-dup; singletons average 3.54 tokens vs head 2.22, 27.5% exceed 4 tokens
singleton_hypothesis_test.caveat: 3.8% residual means head-only mapping leaves a small known undercount; reported, not hidden
